title: Grateful Dead Live at Monterey Performing Arts Center on 1969-06-14
lineage: Joel Pollack's DAT (Tascam DA-40)> Tascam DA-3000 > .wav 16/48
source: Bear’s Master Soundboard Cassettes (Ampex C90) > Dick Latvala's 1st generation cassettes (Tascam 122mkIII deck)(TDK SA-X 100) > Joel Pollack's DAT (16/48)

ai_review.summary: A superb soundboard upgrade captures a mesmerizing Lovelight meltdown, delivering an energetic psychedelic performance.
ai_review.review: The new version of this recording is praised as a clear upgrade over earlier releases, offering crisp soundboard quality even though a true lossless source is still sought. Musically the show shines with a spectacular "meltdown" near the end of the first Lovelight, showcasing a trancelike, Coltrane‑style journey that keeps the energy high throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave high marks (5 and 4 stars) and highlighted excellent recording fidelity plus a standout psychedelic moment, indicating a strong show with top‑tier audio.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Significant improvement over prior versions; clear and balanced mix. Reviewers note it runs correctly (no pitch issues) but are still looking for a fully lossless seed.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds into an intense, psychedelic climax during Lovelight, creating a seamless flow that sustains high momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for embracing the psychedelic "meltdown" vibe and his experimental approach to capturing analog psychedelia.
